assessment: By using single-cell RNA sequencing, elegant computational approaches, protein validation, and in vitro functional assays, this study characterizes the cellular composition and gene expression profiles of the human placenta in mid-gestation. In addition, this work gives new insights into our understanding of trophoblast differentiation in distinct regions of the human placenta. The findings and dataset provided by the authors represent an important resource for readers interested in human development and placenta biology.
